verdict.rationale: The evidence describes agent journeys and workflows written in code or no-code, a scheduled weekly Explorer briefing, and manually initiated workflows in Live Assist. None of these documents a user-definable rule engine in which events automatically trigger actions. The mention of experimenting with 'hand-off rules' is an adjacent agent-behavior setting, not event-triggered automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
